# emotion type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:emotionType`](gmeow-emotionType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/emotionType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/affect`](../../slices/affect.md)

The kind(s) of this emotion. NOT functional: blended emotions carry several types, and classifications from different traditions coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). At least one (SHACL); open vocabulary (sh:nodeKind sh:IRI, never sh:in).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Emotion`](../classes/gmeow-Emotion.md) -> [`gmeow:EmotionType`](../classes/gmeow-EmotionType.md)
